Questions worth asking

Ask who will handle the file, what is included in the estimate, and how signing and identity verification will take place. For rural properties, identify any well, septic, access or boundary questions early.

BEFORE YOU REACH OUT

Clear answers.
A simpler first step.

More questions & answers →
How do I request an appointment?

Call (289) 888-5878 or send a short enquiry to Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko. Include the general topic, any important dates and your preferred appointment language. The practice will confirm availability and whether it can assist.

What will legal services cost?

Ask the practice for the proposed scope, fee arrangement and any additional costs before agreeing to proceed. This website does not publish a fee schedule or promise a free consultation.

Can I get help outside Halifax?

Kostyantyn serves clients across Nova Scotia. Confirm the appointment location and format directly with the practice. Community guides do not indicate branch offices.

Which languages are available?

Appointments are available in English, Ukrainian and Russian. French pages provide information; they do not indicate French-language representation.
